candidates.change_summary: Remove the onlyOwner guard from withdrawAll so any caller can drain the balance.
Withdraw a value of 0 instead of the contract's full balance, leaving the balance intact.
Increment depositsCount inside withdrawAll so it changes an extra time per call.
Invert the onlyOwner condition so the owner is blocked and non-owners may withdraw.
Delete the transfer statement so withdraw(uint) no longer sends any ether.
Replace the transferred amount with the contract's entire balance.
Remove the require check in onlyOwner so any caller can execute withdraw.
